It is also a name for the deep, mystical part of the ocean, which is believed to be the abode of various deities.

Deepu was a prominent Jain monk and philosopher who lived during the 12th century in India. He is known for his work 'Tattvartha Sutra' which is considered a fundamental text in Jain philosophy.
